title: The Sphinx as a dynastic monument carved on an older bedrock outcrop
summary: Jeffrey Drum tells of The Sphinx as a dynastic monument carved on an older bedrock outcrop, about dynastic period at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, I think the Sphinx itself is a dynastic monument >> Uh-huh. that was built on an existing bedrock outcrop within the Sphinx enclosure.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey Drum, talking with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2026, gives his view of the Great Sphinx at Giza in Egypt. He says he thinks the Sphinx is a monument from the time of the pharaohs, but that it was built on a bedrock outcrop that already existed in the Sphinx's enclosure, which would mean the site itself is older than the statue.
